component.name: Pomatez
component.summary: Manage work and breaks with a customizable Pomodoro timer

description.p: This is a community package of Pomatez, maintained independently and unaffiliated with the Pomatez project. It repackages the official upstream Electron AppImage unmodified and follows upstream releases automatically.
Pomatez helps you alternate focused work with regular breaks. Customize work and break intervals, keep a task list, and use desktop notifications, full-screen breaks, strict mode and a compact timer.

The timer works offline with its own sandboxed storage. Network access is optional; update this package with Flatpak rather than the in-app updater. Open at login is not integrated with the host desktop; use your desktop's startup settings to launch flatpak run com.roldanjr.pomatez.
Optional capabilities can be enabled with these commands:

ul.li: Network access for online features: flatpak override --user --share=network com.roldanjr.pomatez
Discord rich presence with a native Discord installation: flatpak override --user --filesystem=xdg-run/discord-ipc-0 com.roldanjr.pomatez
Undo these overrides: flatpak override --user --reset com.roldanjr.pomatez
